reviewerOrPass: Worker B, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Rebuilt the module sequence and credit totals from current EER Appendix A, checked entry, minor and thesis rules directly, then independently reconsidered the current workbook evidence, exact schedules, option distinctness, comparison alignments and reader fields.
findings: The University of Twente 2026–2027 EER B1.1 and B2.3–B2.7 and Appendix A establish an English-taught 180 EC BSc, with four mandatory 15 EC modules in each of the first two years. Each includes an integrated project. The third year has a 30 EC approved minor followed by a 30 EC graduation semester. The graduation semester includes Production of Knowledge (5 EC), the thesis proposal (10 EC) and the supervised bachelor assignment and evaluation (15 EC). Appendix A resolves the curriculum webpage’s extra digit in the Calculus 1B code: 202001196. The two sources agree on credits.

EER B2.5 and the official entry page require completion of modules 1–8 before graduation as the normal rule. Narrow concurrent exceptions allow up to 4 EC in specified modules. This sample uses the ordinary sequence. The minor has a separate concurrent outstanding-credit rule and its own eligibility or approval requirements. Module 11 precedes Module 12, with the assignment starting in week 9 of Module 11 and continuing across the boundary. EER B4.1–B4.3 specifies a 15 EC supervised assignment normally in an external civil engineering organisation, with final report, evaluation and examination.

The early regional research course uses a team and a partner-defined sustainability question. It is feasible at entry and supplies applied research distinct from Twente’s supervised final engineering assignment. Living with Water and Practical GIS align through real study of delta management and spatial methods. Governance of Sustainability adds a bounded stakeholder comparison through institutions, actors and participation. Soils & Aquifers provides field and laboratory science rather than the soil mechanics sequence. Spatial Planning strengthens environmental applications in the second plan, while the closest plan keeps hydrogeology and quantitative study. Transport and structures remain explicit gaps.
